sampled_lines: She wished she could have company
The moon was shining brightly
As shadows danced in the light
And the sounds of the river flowed
In the cold, in the cold and the rain
Gazing at the stars in her eyes
she felt a little lost and alone
The moon was bright enough to find
A solitary soul in the night
And the cold air made her shiver
Blue eyes glistening as the moonlight danced on her skin
Her heart was heavy in her chest
A twinkle in her lonely eyes
Yet she was not afraid
Past the fallen leaves and snow
The moonlight gleamed on her face
To the sound of the children’s voices
Thinking of her silent lover
She found herself in a strange land
When the moonlight came and shone
The moon was shining bright
But her heart was filled with pride
In the shadow of the moonlight
In the swaying arms of the night
And the moonlight seemed so bright
To find her way by the stars
And the moonlight cast the light
With no one to keep her company
The sounds of the street echoed loud
Along the lonely path she went
Lost in the many miles of night
To the moon and the stars above
She moved with a light in her old song
The wind made her shiver at the cold
With a candle in her hand
Looking for her lost love
But the stars kept shining bright
But she soon felt secure
But she felt the warmth of his heart
A young girl singing her song
With no one to guide her along
She prayed to her Lord and Savior
With the sound of her heart
She was a lonely lass
In her heart was a stormy night
The sound of the gong was strange
She felt the cold around her feet
When sudden the starlight brightened
Telling sad stories to the moon
The little blood moon shining through the sky
I saw her by the moonlight
Till in the light of the moon she saw
The lonely path she was on
She was thinking of her loved one
With her heart in her throat
The little things that she knew
Lost in her thoughts and dreams
But she did not feel alone at all
Singing softly to the night
The distant sound of the clock
